طِرْمَاذٌ One who glories, or boasts, vainly, and praises himself for that which is not in him; (L, K;) as also ↓ طِرْمِذَانٌ , (L, K,) and طِرْمِذَارٌ, (L,) or طَرْمَذَارٌ, (K, in which it is mentioned in a separate art.,) but طرمذار is said to have been unknown by IAar: (TA:) or one who boasts of abundance which he does not possess; as also the last of the above-mentioned epithets, which also signifies one who boasts of that which he does not perform. (L.) ―
-b2- Also A horse of generous breed. (Th, L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
